summary.en: Taliban forces are confronting Pakistani security troops along the Kurram border while Pakistan has halted trade at two Iran crossings, affecting the Zangali checkpost and Torkham operations. The United Nations warns that Afghanistan is one step away from famine and the Taliban has opened a road to China that faces security hurdles. Iran remains open to US talks under a Pakistan-brokered deal and a new opium-related hub is emerging in Afghan borderlands with Iran and Pakistan after the Taliban ban. 1,794 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Taliban-styrker konfronterer pakistanske sikkerhetstroppere langs Kurram-grensen mens Pakistan har stanset handelen ved to iranske grenseoverganger, noe som påvirker Zangali-kontrollposten og Torkham-operasjonene. FN advarer om at Afghanistan er ett skritt fra hungersnød, og Taliban har åpnet en vei til Kina som møter sikkerhetsutfordringer. Iran er fortsatt åpent for amerikanske samtaler under en Pakistan-meglet avtale, og et nytt opiummessig knutepunkt vokser frem i afghanske grenseområder med Iran og Pakistan etter Talibans forbud. 1 794 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
